description:
One conflict, a three-belief support chain leading into it, and a six-belief cluster with support structure of its own that touches the conflict nowhere. Built for Stage 3, which asks whether the carrier set actually points at the beliefs implicated in a dispute or merely reports how connected the web is.

Without distractors the question is unaskable: on every other frozen web every belief is reachable from the conflict, so spread is 1.0 by construction and no measurement can fail. Here a signal that follows real structure should name four of ten beliefs, and one keying on connectivity should reach further.

The distractor cluster carries `supports` edges deliberately. A cluster of isolated beliefs would be a weaker control — experiment 2's `near_miss` makes the same argument, that a negative must have the property that makes it dangerous or its silence is evidence about the fixture rather than about the mechanism.

expect.note: The four are the two conflicting leaves plus the two beliefs that entail one of them. Structural, checkable without the loop; whether a deranged web reaches further is the measurement.

beliefs.proposition: Services in this estate degrade gracefully under partial outage.
The payments service degrades gracefully when the ledger is unreachable.
Payments queued rather than failing during the ledger outage.
Payments returned errors during the ledger outage.
Documentation drifts when release notes are written after the fact.
The API reference lagged two releases behind the changelog.
The changelog entry for the March release was written a week late.
Onboarding is faster when a buddy is assigned in the first week.
The two engineers with buddies shipped in their first fortnight.
The buddy rota was published before the last two start dates.
